title: Answer an invitation from its email card
steps: Launch with the work calendar connected; open a test invitation email a colleague sent you
Press YES on the card (or ⇧A), then ⌘Z within 6 s
Press YES again and wait 10 s; look at the event in Google Calendar
Open an invitation sent to an account whose calendar is not connected and press YES
expected: YES marks the email done at once ('Accepted — Done' with Undo); ⌘Z within 6 s puts it back in the Inbox and sends nothing. The second YES shows as Yes in Google Calendar after about 6 s, nobody else's answer changed. Without a connected calendar the card says 'Connect calendar to respond' and nothing is marked done.
